title: Account
loginNameHint: This is what you sign in with (stored in the backend phone-number column). Contact an administrator to change it.
profileSectionHint: The name and email shown across the system.
fullNameTooLong: Full name must be at most 100 characters
securitySectionHint: The password you sign in with.
devicesSectionHint: Where your account is currently open. Revoke anything you do not recognise.
deviceRevokeConfirm: That device will be signed out immediately and must sign in again.
logoutSectionHint: End the session on this device, or on every device.
logoutConfirm: You will need to sign in again on this device. Other devices are not affected.
